notes.title: HSH2 PART2 IS NOW AVAILABLE !
notes.content:
We want to sincerely apologize to everyone as HSH2 Part 2 has been delayed. Now, HSH2 Part 2 is available as a free update on Steam for those who had already purchased HSH2.

For those who haven't tried HSH yet, be sure to grab one cause HSH2 is currently 20% off on Steam. 

Patch Updates 1.1.0 (This patch will take roughly 3.6 GB)

1. Add more contents
2. Add new mode 'Chapter Select'
3. Add Simplified Chinese language
4. Fix minor bugs

Remark : For those who had already played the first part, you can continue playing from the previous saves.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is now ready. There are some major improvements as follow:

1. Fix audio problems 
2. Improve the Thai dancer's AI systems  
3. Fix unload levels 
4. Fix problem where players cannot control the character when being attacked 
5. Fix problem where shadow is not appearing in the cut-scene 
6. Adjust subtitles not synchronizing with the voice 
7. Add herb tutorial
